world.description: A rooftop penthouse at golden hour over a city of towers.

start.text: The city never looks better than at this hour. Stay a while.

more.text: Have a look at the view, then try the lights: the switches are by the doors.

start.text: Come in, make yourself at home. The light is best at this hour.

more.text: Everything in here opens: try the drawers and the cupboards.

start.text: Coffee's just made. Help yourself, the mugs are on the counter.

intro.objective: Walk through, meet your guests, switch the lights, change the time of day and take a photo.
intro.tagline: Three bedrooms, a terrace pool and the whole city at your feet.
intro.title: Skyline Penthouse

world.name: Skyline Penthouse
